display_long_description:
Apple Taggers VR is an action-packed multiplayer VR experience built around fast movement, smooth locomotion, and chaotic fun.

Become an Apple and enter vibrant arenas where players climb, jump, and sprint using full VR motion. One player starts as the tagger, and the rest must escape using skillful movement, parkour routes, and quick reactions. Get tagged — and the chase continues.

Designed for casual fun and competitive play, Apple Taggers is easy to learn but hard to master. Whether you’re playing with friends or jumping into public lobbies, every round is unpredictable and intense.

🔥 FEATURES

🍎 Fast-paced multiplayer tag gameplay

🥽 Built from the ground up for VR movement

🏃 Smooth climbing, jumping, and locomotion

🎮 Easy to learn, high skill ceiling

🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Play with friends or public lobbies

🎨 Bright, fun environments optimized for VR

🚀 Regular updates and new content planned

If you love movement-based VR games and nonstop action, Apple Taggers VR delivers pure adrenaline and fun.
